info.title: Wearable Insights Engine
info.description: Deterministic wearable analytics with a bounded LLM narrative layer, exposed for ClaimGuard. Server-to-server only.

get.description: Cache occupancy and warm state — operational visibility, no user data.

post.description: Deterministic layers only: baselines → window comparisons → associations.

Explainable underwriting signals. Fully deterministic — no narrative in this build.

The ``narrative`` field stays ``None`` until the separate underwriting safety profile
is reviewed and enabled; the deterministic signals are useful to an underwriter on
their own, and shipping them first keeps this surface reviewable in isolation.
Reward-side branch: streaks, tier, and discount *eligibility* (never an applied discount).
Fatigue-risk context for a motor incident. Liability evidence, never fraud evidence.
Mock attestation + credibility, cross-checked against this applicant's own signals.

Risk-side branch: anomalies → bounded, safety-gated nudge set.

Always returns 200.  ``comparison`` is deterministic and useful even when the LLM leg
fails, so an upstream model outage must not cost the caller the analysis as well; the
failure is reported in ``error`` instead.  A clean day yields an empty nudge set with
no LLM call at all.

Advance the simulated intraday feed one sync and report anything it raised.

The response carries the *advanced* cursor and the *updated* nudge state, so the
caller stores what it receives and never performs clock arithmetic or state
bookkeeping itself.

analysis_date.title: Analysis Date
analysis_date.description: Day to analyse; defaults to profile.end_date.

Anomaly.title: Anomaly
Anomaly.description: Deterministically detected deviation for one day (FR-002, FR-021).

is_mock.title: Is Mock
is_mock.description: Always true. Every rendering surface must label this a mock.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Mock attestation standing in for an electronic health record / laboratory integration. Generated data — not a real medical record, and not a diagnosis.

CandidateAssociation.title: CandidateAssociation
CandidateAssociation.description: Non-causal co-occurrence produced by a defined rule (FR-010).

ComparisonObject.title: ComparisonObject
ComparisonObject.description: Compact, LLM-facing contract between analysis and inference (FR-009).

Contributor.title: Contributor
Contributor.description: One weighted input, carrying its own evidence so the score is explainable.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Derived from voluntarily shared wearable data as corroborating context for how an incident occurred. It indicates fatigue risk, not fraud, and is not a medical assessment. It must be reviewed by a human adjuster alongside other evidence.

incident_at.title: Incident At
incident_at.description: ISO-8601 local datetime of the incident, e.g. '2026-08-24T07:40'.

continuous_drive_minutes.title: Continuous Drive Minutes
continuous_drive_minutes.description: Self-reported/telematics drive duration before the incident.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Matches the error envelope of the existing 001 REST contract.

LiveCursor.title: LiveCursor
LiveCursor.description:
Position in the simulated intraday feed — replaces the Streamlit deque.

``seed_buffer`` is pure, so the whole rolling buffer is reconstructible from these
five fields.  The response echoes back an *advanced* cursor, so the caller never
performs clock arithmetic itself.

LiveNudgeStateEntry.title: LiveNudgeStateEntry
LiveNudgeStateEntry.description: One anomaly code's episode/cooldown state, keyed by AnomalyCode value.

nudge_state.title: Nudge State
nudge_state.description: Round-tripped episode/cooldown state. Send back what you last received.

now.title: Now
now.description: Caller clock (epoch seconds) for deterministic cooldown in tests.

nudge_state.title: Nudge State
nudge_state.description: Persist this and send it back on the next tick.

model.title: Model
model.description: Must be a key of config.MODEL_OPTIONS.

skip_llm.title: Skip Llm
skip_llm.description: Run only the deterministic layers and return them.

LlmOptions.title: LlmOptions
LlmOptions.description: Per-request model selection for the LLM-backed endpoints.

MetricComparison.title: MetricComparison
MetricComparison.description: Current-vs-baseline comparison for a single metric across windows (FR-009).

Nudge.title: Nudge
Nudge.description: User-facing item wrapping one Insight, raised from ≥1 anomalies (FR-003, FR-007).

NudgeResponse.title: NudgeResponse
NudgeResponse.description:
Note the deliberate 200-with-``error`` contract.

``comparison`` is deterministic and useful even when the LLM leg fails, so an upstream
model outage is reported here rather than as an HTTP error status that would throw the
analysis away along with the narrative.

NudgeSet.title: NudgeSet
NudgeSet.description: Bounded daily nudge collection (FR-005, FR-006, SC-008).

ProfileMeta.title: ProfileMeta
ProfileMeta.description: Non-metric identity echoed back so callers can render a profile card.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: Caller-scoped id (e.g. 'cg_user_7'); overrides the engine default.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Last date in the generated series. REQUIRED: the engine must never fall back to date.today() in a request path, or responses change silently at UTC midnight and differ between caller and sidecar timezones.

ProfileRef.title: ProfileRef
ProfileRef.description:
A reproducible pointer to a synthetic wearable history.

This is the whole persistence story for wearable data: ClaimGuard stores these six
fields on ``WearableProfile`` and the engine reconstructs the identical 90-day series
on demand.  Nothing about the series itself is ever stored.

exercise_sessions_claimed.title: Exercise Sessions Claimed
exercise_sessions_claimed.description: Self-declared weekly exercise sessions — the field cross-checked against wearable data.

UnderwritingComposite.title: UnderwritingComposite
UnderwritingComposite.description: The three headline tiles. `volatility` is the only risk-polarity number.

UnderwritingSignal.title: UnderwritingSignal
UnderwritingSignal.description: One explainable signal shown as a row in the underwriter's report.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: This is a decision-support signal derived from voluntarily shared wellness data. It is not a medical assessment, contains no diagnosis, and must not be the sole basis for an underwriting decision. All signals require human review.

WindowComparison.title: WindowComparison
WindowComparison.description: Comparison of current value vs. one named baseline window.
